in_sanskrit.name: उधय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who bestows from above, the one who uplifts, the one who is active and enthusiastic.

in_hindi.name: Udhaya
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Rising, Dawn, Awakening
in_hindi.long_meaning: Udhaya एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Udhaya is derived from the Sanskrit root 'udh' meaning 'up', 'rise'. This name signifies the rising sun, the dawn, and the awakening of the spirit. It is a name that inspires courage, determination and new beginnings.
